data.case_title: Hunting license application rejected due to expired insurance proof
data.title: Jagdschein application rejected – insurance proof expired

sender.name: Kreis Musterdithmarschen – Fachdienst Waffen und Jagd

data.summary: The Kreis Musterdithmarschen (Fachdienst Waffen und Jagd) rejected Tjark Beispielholm's application for a three-year hunting license (Jagdschein) because the insurance proof he submitted for the required hunting liability insurance expired on 30 June 2026. The authority will issue the license without a new application as soon as a current insurance confirmation is submitted.
data.explanation: The authority cannot issue the hunting license because the proof of hunting liability insurance you submitted is no longer valid. You can simply send a current insurance confirmation and the license will be issued without having to apply again. If you disagree with this decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch); the app will show you the deadline for this once it processes the delivery date. If you do nothing and let the deadline pass without objecting, the rejection becomes final, but you can still reapply later once you have valid insurance.

key_facts.label: Reason for rejection (abgelaufener Versicherungsnachweis)
key_facts.quote: Der Nachweis, den Sie vorgelegt haben, ist am 30.06.2026 abgelaufen.

key_facts.label: Legal basis for required insurance
key_facts.quote: Nach § 17 Abs. 1 Satz 2 des Bundesjagdgesetzes setzt er eine Jagdhaftpflichtversicherung voraus.

key_facts.label: Deemed delivery rule (Bekanntgabe)
key_facts.quote: Ein Bescheid, den die Behörde mit einfachem Brief verschickt, gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben (§ 110 Abs. 2 LVwG).

items.title: Submit a valid hunting liability insurance confirmation
items.action: Send the Kreis a current confirmation of your hunting liability insurance (Jagdhaftpflichtversicherung)
items.consequence: The three-year hunting license will then be issued without requiring a new application
